pr_title: fix(test runner): perform duplicates check before filtering
pr_body:
Previously, this check happened after filtering by only and lines, but it should happen before that.
Also, fix the error message when multiple duplicate issues are present.

Fixes #14034.

issue_context.title: [BUG] TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'retry')
issue_context.body:
- Clone any test w/o updating the title
- Make it .only
- Run tests

review_comments: Why do you check for `only` after the filtration, but check dupes before the filtration?
